liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **New Speedway Boogie** (1 review): Taper was shut down by someone in the Dead organization during an interesting version of this song [4]

## The recordings

- **gd70-05-16.aud.cotsman.17027.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 6 songs; 28 min; rated 2.33/5 by 3 [1]. Said about its sound: Taper sat near the stage: instruments are present and direct from the amps, vocals low, little PA captured [10]
- **gd70-05-16.aud.weiner.14769.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 6 songs; 26 min; rated 2.8/5 by 10 [2]. Said about its sound: Recording has a lot of audience noise and is far from great; Sound isn't official-release quality, but the show is a rarer 1970 one; Jerry's guitar is very clear, but vocals are low and the music somewhat muddy [3][4][6]

## Around the show

- Reviewer's first Dead show; most of the crowd came to see Hendrix, and Cactus was also on the bill [5]
- Band walked out in cowboy hats, and about 200 people up front jumped around from the start [5]
- The Dead played for under an hour, according to this reviewer [5]
- The Dead's manager interfered with the taping, spoiling an otherwise decent recording [7]
- Reviewer lived in Wyndmoor, PA, about 2.5 miles from the stadium, and heard the very loud concert from outside the house [8]
- Taper was caught by Sam Cutler, ending the recording [10]
- Bill was Cactus, Steve Miller, Hendrix, then a really long Dead set to close [12]
- Weather was warm and clear; tickets cost roughly $15, as recalled [12]
- The music is on par with other shows from the same era [4]
- Reviewer had just heard 5-15-70 and the night before, and marveled the band played again on the 16th [13]
- Band may have been tired after the Fillmore marathon and St Louis, with another college gig listed on the 17th [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd70-05-16.aud.cotsman.17027.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD>MC>?>C>CD>EAC>SHN [1]. Also: Chain runs audience mic to cassette copies, CD, EAC extraction and SHN, with an unknown step in between; This version derives from the Noah Weiner seed, pitch-corrected in Sound Forge, with edits and encoding by JCotsman; Seeded to etree through D Litfin [1]
- **gd70-05-16.aud.weiner.14769.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Noah Weiner; source: Audience [2]. Also: Tape came from an attendee, who got it in the early 1990s via a GD bulletin board or Relix magazine; Owner believed his cassette was second generation; a non-tracked CD was burned directly from it [2]
